item.title: 16 Times Tom And Jerry Actually Spoke
item.description: The duo debuted on February 10, 1940, in 'Puss Gets the Boot' (1940), so we’re celebrating with a look at the rare occasions the normally mute duo spoke up.

item.title: Sony Shelves Original Thai-Inspired Film From ‘Amphibia’ And ‘Steven Universe’ Creators
item.description: After two years in development, Sony has pulled the plug on the culturally rooted animated feature, calling it “not commercial enough.”

item.title: ‘I, Chihuahua’ Kicks Out At Two: Jorge Gutiérrez Relaunches The Shelved Netflix Project
item.description: The animated feature, once scrapped by Netflix, returns with new backing from Snafu Pictures and heads to Berlin's European Film Market.

item.title: From Poem To Puppets: How BAFTA-Nominated ‘Two Black Boys In Paradise’ Became A Stop-Motion Act Of Love
item.description: A deeply personal poem on self-acceptance becomes a five-year effort to craft a stop-motion short centered on Black queer love.

item.title: ASIFA-Hollywood Launches Will Ryan Excellence In Humor Award
item.description: The annual award, backed by Ryan's family, will support emerging animation artists and be unveiled at the 53rd Annie Awards on February 21.

item.title: Isamu Imakake’s Metaphysical Fantasy ‘Dragon Heart’ Sets U.S. Digital Debut
item.description: Isamu Imakake’s spirit-world fantasy secures U.S. distribution following its Japanese theatrical run, arriving on digital platforms March 3.

item.title: ‘Allegro Non Troppo’ At 50: GKIDS Acquires Bruno Bozzetto Catalog
item.description: GKIDS picks up Bruno Bozzetto’s full catalog as the restored cult classic gets a 50th anniversary screening in New York alongside 'Fantasia.'

item.title: Anime Landmark ‘Ninja Scroll’ Gets 4K Restoration, Heads To Berlinale
item.description: Yoshiaki Kawajiri’s 1993 anime thriller will premiere in a newly scanned and remastered edition at the Berlin film festival before physical release in 2027.

item.title: Why Director David Derrick Needed To Follow Up ‘Moana 2’ With An Uncompromising Webcomic
item.description: The studio system vet leaves blockbuster scale behind to explore myth, violence, and nature in a stark, self-driven project with help from his readers.

item.title: Inside The Making Of ‘The Quinta’s Ghost’: Gothic Horror, 3D Brushstrokes, And 35mm Film
item.description: A deep dive into the experimental pipeline, painterly 3D design, and bold film-print process behind Spain’s Oscar-shortlisted short.
